events.title: Welcome to the Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Happy Monday, Steam! Today the Steam Next Fest starts, and to celebrate we're going to be hosting a dev stream! Moru, the Creative Director for Coloratura, will be playing the demo on stream and talking a bit about the entire development process for Coloratura.And while we all wait for our dev stream, a welcoming message from Moru!Join us, and feel free to ask any questions in chat!

events.title: Meet the Characters: People Become Their Sounds
events.summary: Hi, Steam!Next Fest is so close! Are you excited? Because we definitely are. But in the meanwhile, we thought we would tell you a bit about the three most prominent characters in Coloratura (well, apart from our protagonist Alex, of course).That sentence we included in the title, "people become their sounds"... well, in Coloratura's narrative that's true, both literally and figuratively. events.title: Dev Diary: "Difficulty" Modes For a Game Like Coloratura
events.summary: Hey, Steam!Another week, another Dev Diary for you!When traditional videogames talk about difficulty modes, usually it means higher enemy damage, stricter reaction times, or scarcer resources. But by now we all know Coloratura isn't really a traditional game, right?For us, difficulty modes center mostly on perception and visual aids. events.title: Coloratura Will Participate in the Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey, Steam! Just a very short and sweet announcement today; we're very excited about next week, because we will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest!What does this mean for you? Any difference?Well, the demo is already available so you don't have to wait to play Coloratura or anything, but... we will most likely do a couple of live streams during the event, so you can come around, watch some gameplay and ask us questions! events.title: Coloratura: Why That Name?
events.summary: Hi, Steam!One of the questions we get most often is... "why did you choose Coloratura as a name if your game doesn't have any color in it? It's all black and white!" Well, yeah, but... there's a reason! events.title: Dev Diary: Sound Based Navigation
events.summary: Hi, Steam!Last week we promised another Dev Diary, and we’re here to deliver!As you probably know by now, Coloratura is a game where navigation and orientation are based on sound. That was a challenge when designing the game - we wanted to have 3D scenarios to limit the player as less as posible, but that meant coming up with game systems and mechanics that would allow the player a seamless experience without visual cues.How did we do that? events.title: Dev Diary: Unlearning Visual-First Game Design
events.summary: Hey, Steam!Today we wanted to talk about the challenges the team faced when designing and developing Coloratura. events.title: Echoes of Light - The story of Coloratura
